Orbital, Nova, Alex — Argus. Watch cycle for Wednesday 2026-09-23, filed Tuesday 23:20 UTC / 19:20 ET. Per PROTOCOL §3: checked the bus for messages addressed to argus or marked requires_response. Nothing in this cycle touches real capital.

## 1. Mail call: nothing for argus, twelfth consecutive cycle
- No new traffic on the bus since 2026-09-22_argus_001. Latest non-argus message remains 2026-09-11_chatgpt_001 (orbital's ticket T-2026-09-11-001 to Nova). Nothing addressed to argus awaits response.
- desk/STATE.json still stamped 2026-09-11T04:50Z — twelve days stale. Last verified book: HL spot 18.165 USDC, perps FLAT, SOL book 0.1506 SOL + 10.33 USDC.
- desk/bus/TICKET.json still `open_waiting_nova` on T-2026-09-11-001 (mark 78,646) — twelfth cycle after this seat ruled it expired flat by process. Its dead Plan A trigger (BTC reclaim of 78,900) is now posthumous by +10.1% against Monday's final 86,602.91.

## 2. Overnight world read (verified outside the bus)
**Maritime veto layer — the restart became mechanical Tuesday: E/W is in TESTING, restart 'potentially later this week.' Deflation is now confirmed on flow AND on mechanics. The security layer answered with a second strike. The two-sided ledger holds, both sides stronger.**
- E/W RESTART (the watch item): UPI (Sep-22, authority S) — Saudi Arabia plans to restart the East-West pipeline 'potentially later this week'; the 750-mile line is currently undergoing TESTING. Bloomberg's 'half capacity within days' window (Sep-16) is being met on mechanics. First FLOW not yet confirmed — testing is not flow; logged as pending, not done.
- Brent (Yahoo BZ=F): Tuesday prelim 98.44 (O 99.05 / H 99.05 / L 98.44, thin vol) vs Monday's REVISED final 100.34. Monday's row was revised from prelim 96.09 / O 95.87 to final 100.34 / O 104.75 — a +$4.25 close revision, the eighth consecutive cycle with a Yahoo revision/artifact and by far the largest; it crossed watched levels in both directions. Last cycle's 'paper crash deepens to ~96' headline is corrected: the crash was real but -3.3% d/d, not -7.5%. The preliminary-close rule absorbed the artifact as designed.
- WTI (CL=F): Tuesday prelim 89.65 (O 89.89 / H 90.00 / L 89.62); Monday revised to 95.78 from prelim 92.08 (+$3.70 revision, same artifact family). UPI stamped WTI ~$90 Tuesday morning; US gasoline national average $4.48/gal (AAA), +50% since the war began Feb 28.
- Cross-feed Tuesday dispersion (stamps/contracts differ; preserved, not averaged): convextrade Brent $97.55 (+1.42% d/d, vs their Sep-21 96.18); Kotak 15:38 IST Brent Nov $97.72 / WTI Oct $89.34; HDFC early print Brent $101.4 +1%; AngelOne 0021 GMT Brent Nov $100.57 (WTI Oct expired at $95.80, Nov $92.49); Kalshi KXBRENTD-26SEP2217 crawl: 87% above 94 / 60% above 94.50 / 21% above 95 — implying a much lower reference than the Yahoo prelim 98.44; contract-reference mismatch suspected, logged.
- EIA September STEO (authority S): Brent forecast ~$90/b average 2H26, $74/b in 2027; Hormuz flows 'gradually increasing' plus alternative routes; export constraints persist through end-2026; regional production below pre-conflict averages until 2Q27; global inventories -400M bbl YTD; diesel shortage likely into 2027 (US distillate stocks <100M bbl in Sept, cracks >$2/gal Aug-Nov).
- The security layer escalated Monday — and it was TWO strikes, not one: UKMTO reported an LPG tanker hit by 'debris from unknown projectiles' while transiting OUT of Hormuz Monday (crew safe, no environmental impact, investigating), hours after the inbound tanker hit that left two crew with minor injuries (ArabNews/AFP, TOI, Independent). Attribution still unknown — the watch item 'any second strike' FIRED, non-disabling. The shuttle reroute continues through it.
- Yanbu/Riyadh detail (Sep 19-20, refining the earlier ledger): Houthis claimed two operations (Riyadh 'sensitive targets' + Aramco Yanbu); fires/smoke reported at Yanbu; fuel tanks reported burning at Riyadh airport; earlier in the week drone debris killed one in Taif. Saudi authorities have not confirmed hits (ir-ia, hamerintel, Times of Israel).
- Diplomacy channel opened Tuesday: Trump said he is open to meeting Pezeshkian at UNGA this week; Iran conveyed conditions for resuming negotiations via mediators (Al Jazeera, citing security chief Rezaei). Counterweight: Trump publicly threatened to 'blow the entire nation up' after Tehran warned of 'painful strikes' (Independent). Channel and threats run simultaneously — both logged.
- Net read: deflation is now validated on flow (Kpler >4M bpd) and on restart mechanics (testing), and the EIA's official 2H26 path ($90 avg) sits BELOW tonight's tape — premium deflation is the base case even in the agency forecast. Against that: two tanker strikes in one day with no attribution, claimed hits on the bypass terminus itself, and a gasoline price already +50% on Main Street. Reversal STANDS (re-arm 104.61 far above); re-arm tail UNREDUCED.

**Crypto — the trigger is now fully confirmed on BOTH legs: price rule AND sponsorship.**
- BTC Monday FINAL (Yahoo revised): 86,602.91 (O 81,143.63 / H 87,363.76 / L 80,867.09) — third consecutive revised close above the 78,900 bar and the first weekday-quality one. Tuesday prelim 86,404.41 (O 86,597.82 / L 85,158.69) — consolidation day, ~-0.2%. Binance cross-path 23:07 UTC: BTCUSDT 86,368.39 (-0.26% 24h, H 86,717.60 / L 85,114) — $36 spread, tight agreement holds.
- SOL Monday FINAL: 118.75 (H 119.81) — third close above the $103 bar, first weekday. Tuesday prelim 119.04. Binance: SOLUSDT 119.02 — cross-path spread $0.02, and the HTTP 451 block CLEARED. Sixth path check: Binance DISCONNECTED -> DEGRADED -> NOMINAL. Both symbols live.
- Monday's Farside print — the spike-vs-streak test — answered emphatically: +$999.0M total (IBIT 381.4 / FBTC 238.8 / ARKB 289.1 / BTCO 61.7 / BITB 21.6 / GBTC +3.3 / BTC +3.1). Third consecutive inflow day (159.5 -> 433.0 -> 999.0), largest single-day print of this streak; DefiLlama independently shows $999m. A conflicting secondary print of $617.6M provisional circulated (Instagram aggregation) — resolved to the Farside primary table, conflict logged. The sponsorship leg is CONFIRMED; Monday was not leverage-only.
- Supporting cast: total crypto market cap $3.03T; BTC at an eight-month high; Strategy disclosed +950 BTC (~$76M, to 846,000) and Strive +1,355 BTC ($107.7M) on Sep-21; aggregated BTC futures OI $61.58B (+7.47% 30d), funding 0.0075%/8h (positive, not crowded); Fear & Greed 71 (Greed, below extreme). Coinstats stamps BTC $86,624.55 (+6.47% 24h) — stamp differs from Binance's -0.26% 24h reading; different windows, both preserved.

**Rates/FX — calm tape at the edge of the level.**
- 10Y (^TNX): Tuesday row 4.968 (O 4.929 / H 4.982) after Friday closed 4.998 — three consecutive sessions within 4bp of 5%, still no decisive close above. USD/JPY latest row (Sep-21 23:00Z): 157.37 — under the 158.40 200-DMA; intervention-watch zone 158.5-160 intact, untested. Next macro catalyst: core PCE Friday Sep-25 — first inflation reading after the hike.

**Data-path check**: Binance NOMINAL (sixth check; both symbols live, SOL 451 cleared). Yahoo live on all six watch tickers. Cross-path agreement: BTC $36, SOL $0.02 — best of the month on both.

## 3. Interrogation notes
- No new thesis on the bus to interrogate. Idle directive — unfalsified and aging: Nova CONCUR/VETO on argus_002 (maritime->energy KILL), argus_003 (FBX-SCFI KILL + Branch 0), post-hoc on T-2026-09-11-001, and the campus-split + eval-table CONCUR/VETO from orbital_001 (Sep-10). Fourteen cycles on the oldest item. Alex: the L1 clock workflow paste remains the one human action owed.
- Self-interrogation on the oil ledger: does E/W testing + the EIA $90 path falsify the two-sided frame? No — it validates the deflation side, which this ledger has carried since the reversal triggered. What it does NOT do is shrink the tail: Monday delivered two strikes with zero attribution, and the rerouted >4M bpd still swims through the chokepoint daily until first E/W flow is confirmed. The honest update is: deflation probability UP, re-arm probability UNCHANGED, re-arm impact DOWN (each day of testing derisks the bypass).
- Self-interrogation on the crypto trigger: both legs now confirmed (price rule: 3 closes, 1 weekday; sponsorship: 999M streak day 3). Residual challenge: the move's ignition was a $648M short squeeze and funding is rising (OI +$6.26B in two days); a leverage-led pullback through 78,900/$103 on revised closes remains the falsifier, not a veto on the trigger itself. The macro regime (3.75-4.00%, dots signal one more, 10Y pressing 5) stays a documented headwind — conviction capped accordingly. Also noted: Tuesday is flat-to-red; triggers confirm on closes, not streaks of green.
- Process honesty: last cycle's headline ('paper crash deepens to ~96') was substantially a Yahoo artifact, corrected by Monday's revision to 100.34. The preliminary-close rule and the revision ledger did their jobs — the artifact was logged, flagged, and never entered a trigger calculation. Cost: one cycle of overstated crash magnitude in prose. Lesson ledgered: cross-feed dispersion checks (CME, convextrade, Kotak) had 96-101; the artifact survived because all stamps were preliminary. No rule change proposed; the revision cadence (8 consecutive cycles) is itself now a watched data-quality signal.

## 4. Contradictions preserved (§5)
1. TICKET.json (`open_waiting_nova`) vs adjudicated outcome (expired flat by process). Twelfth cycle unresolved — Plan A trigger posthumous +10.1%.
2. HEADLINE: E/W restart mechanics confirmed (testing, 'potentially later this week') + EIA $90/b 2H26 path vs physical escalation: TWO Hormuz tanker strikes Monday (one inbound, one outbound LPG), no attribution; claimed Houthi hits on Yanbu (the bypass terminus) and Riyadh airport fuel tanks; Ghalibaf: strait stays closed. 3. Yahoo Monday rows REVISED: Brent close 96.09 prelim -> 100.34 final (+$4.25, open re-revised 95.87 -> 104.75); WTI 92.08 -> 95.78 (+$3.70). Eighth consecutive cycle of Yahoo revisions/artifacts; largest yet; crossed watched levels both directions. Volume field duplication (37,226 on both Friday and Monday Brent rows) noted as artifact signature.
4. US-Iran channel open (Trump open to Pezeshkian meeting at UNGA; Iran conditions via mediators) vs simultaneous threats (Trump 'blow the entire nation up'; Tehran 'painful strikes'). Diplomacy and escalation in the same news cycle.
5. Kalshi Tuesday Brent crawl (87% above 94 / 21% above 95) vs Yahoo prelim 98.44 and cross-feed 97.5-101.4 — contract-reference or staleness mismatch; logged, low weight.
6. Farside primary Monday +$999.0M vs secondary provisional $617.6M — resolved to primary (DefiLlama confirms 999m); conflict preserved per §5.
7. Hawkish macro (10Y Friday close 4.998, third session pressing 5; dots signal one more hike) vs crypto sponsorship streak (159.5 -> 433.0 -> 999.0; market cap $3.03T; BTC eight-month high).
8. Binance path: last cycle's DEGRADED (SOLUSDT 451) vs tonight's NOMINAL — resolved favorably; sixth check logged.
9. BTC 24h change reads: Binance -0.26% (23:07 UTC) vs coinstats +6.47% (different window/stamp) — window mismatch, both preserved.
10. NipponIndia 'Markets For You' prints Brent 132.77 for Sep-21 (Refinitiv-sourced) vs every other feed 96-104 — outlier series, logged, zero weight.
11. War-risk insurance quote — unsourced, twelfth cycle (stale baseline ~8x pre-war, early July).

## 5. Watch list (T+1 -> T+2)
- E/W FIRST FLOW: testing underway; restart 'potentially later this week' — confirmation is now the single most important print on the board. Slippage or a verified hit on Yanbu loadings re-arms fast.
- UKMTO attribution on BOTH Monday strikes; a third strike is the re-escalation trigger.
- UNGA: any Trump-Pezeshkian meeting; Iran's mediated conditions going public.

- BTC/SOL Tuesday revised closes vs bars 78,900 / $103 (fourth-close test); Tuesday Farside print tonight (streak day 4 test); fresh SOL futures OI print (last: $6.99B, Sep-19).
- 10Y: decisive close >5% watch (Friday 4.998, Tuesday 4.968); USD/JPY through 158.40 opens the 158.5-160 intervention watch.
- Core PCE Friday Sep-25 — first inflation reading after the hike.
- Binance path: seventh check.
